name: Peres
title: Judah's firstborn twin son
summary: Peres was the son of Judah and Tamar, born under dramatic circumstances as a twin brother to Zerah. His name means 'breach' because he broke out first at birth. He became the ancestor of a significant lineage that includes King David and ultimately Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: The Birth - The Breach
keyEvents.description: During the birth, Serah put out her hand first, but Perez broke through and was born first. The midwife exclaimed, 'What a breakthrough you have made!' and he was named Perez.

keyEvents.title: Tamar's Righteousness
keyEvents.description: Perez was conceived when Tamar, who had been denied her rightful husband Shelah, disguised herself as a prostitute and slept with Judah. Judah later acknowledged that she was more righteous than he was.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of the Perez Lineage
keyEvents.description: Perez had sons named Hezron and Hamul, and through Hezron the family line continued that would lead to King David.

keyEvents.title: In Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Perez is mentioned in Matthew's genealogy as an important ancestor of Jesus Christ, along with his mother Tamar, who is one of the few women named in the lineage.

keyEvents.title: Blessing over Ruth's Marriage
keyEvents.description: When Boaz took Ruth as his wife, the people blessed them with the wish that their house might be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah.
